title: Stocks to Follow — candidates beyond the core watchlist
html:
Core watchlist: SPY · AAPL · TSLA · XOM · NOW · DELL · PLTR (NOW, DELL, PLTR added Oct 20)

Candidates were picked for three things: very liquid options (tight spreads), clean technical trends, and relevance to what's driving this market (AI, oil, rates).

Gauges to watch but not trade yet: TLT (long-term Treasury bonds; falling = rising rates, a headwind for stocks) and USO (oil; drives XOM and inflation).

Read

Most of the "buy the pullback" setups right now are in AI and semiconductors (QQQ, NVDA, SMH, MU, AMD) after eight straight days of chip selling. The edge study says these setups have a modest upside edge historically. But this is exactly the crowded trade that blew up Situational Awareness in July, and NVDA and MU report in the next few weeks. Use small size and a defined stop.

Setups to study and paper-trade, not recommendations.
